name: Oona
aliases: queen and mother of all faeries
description: Oona was the ancient queen of the faeries of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, creator of Maralen and Oko, whose meddling caused the plane's transformation.

description_citations.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Oona was the ancient queen of the faeries of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, creator of Maralen and Oko, whose meddling caused the plane's transformation.

citations.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: All faeries came from Oona, and they gathered secrets and dreamstuff to empower her.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

bio.text: Oko was her first attempt at an heir and first avatar, who rebelled and left the plane after he sparked.

citations.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

bio.text: She made Maralen as a duplicate avatar and gave her a piece of her soul to preserve her memories.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

bio.text: Oona's meddling left the plane's aspects bleeding into one another, and after the Great Aurora turned the plane to Shadowmoor, a coalition of Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor defeated her.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.
"Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

bio.text: Maralen, who defied her maker, is said to have ultimately killed her.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

bio.text: Her downfall let Eirdu and Isilu emerge and gave birth to the Mass of Mysteries.

citations.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.
"The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

bio.text: Later, Maralen found petals of Oona's flesh in her chamber and feared that Oona was returning, and Rhys came at her with a poisoned dagger believing she was Oona, until Oko told him otherwise.

citations.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

status.text: Oona was defeated and her body destroyed, though her consciousness is said to remain hidden and recovering, and Maralen feared her return in December 2025.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

citations.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The faeries of Lorwyn are largely unaffected by the Great Aurora, though Oona's consolidation of power leads some to branch into white.
timeline.quote: The faeries of Lorwyn were the only tribe to be largely unaffected by the Great Aurora

citation.text: "Faerie", section "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Oona's defeat, Maralen becomes the new great faerie who rules from Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: After Oona's defeat, Maralen became the new great faerie who rules from Glen Elendra and stewards the plane.

citation.text: "Faerie", section "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sigric, Morecote and Erewaker die on the journey to the dawnglove clearing, harried by the Deffroad clique's attempt to resurrect Oona.
timeline.quote: though all three died along the journey

citation.text: "List of secondary characters/Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Ferrafor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona uses the Great Aurora to control the plane by manipulating its celestial cycle, alternating it every 300 years.
timeline.quote: used the Great Aurora to grant herself control of the plane by manipulating its celestial cycle

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Great Mending disrupts the cycle, and Oona fears she may be affected by the Great Aurora.
timeline.quote: This continued until the cycle was disrupted in 4520 after the Great Mending

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona creates Oko as a vessel for her memories, but he turns against her and flees.
timeline.quote: a shapeshifter named Oko who turned his inherited intellect against her

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona creates Maralen and instills her with a piece of her own soul.
timeline.quote: and instilled the imposter with a piece of her own soul

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen gains sentience and joins others to investigate Oona.
timeline.quote: banded together with others from across Lorwyn to investigate Oona and the effect she was having on the plane

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane into Shadowmoor, a coalition including Maralen and Rhys defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona's body is destroyed but her consciousness remains, determined to reclaim her power.
timeline.quote: Though Oona was defeated and her body was destroyed, her unforgiving consciousness remained

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona creates a pair of fae from a petal of her body to carry her memories into the coming world; the first, Oko, is deemed a failure and flees.
timeline.quote: As a contingency, Oona took a petal from her floral body and used it to create a pair of fae that could each carry her memories forward into the coming world.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona deploys the second heir, who will become Maralen, into Lorwyn as the Great Aurora nears.
timeline.quote: As the Great Aroura neared, Oona deployed this second heir into Lorwyn.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona senses the Great Aurora approaching prematurely and plots to remain in power and unchanged through the plane's transformation.
timeline.quote: Oona began to plot to ensure that she remained in power and unchanged when the plane’s transformation occurred.

citation.text: "Oona", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yew treefolk dwindle until only Colfenor remains, whose offspring The Sapling is destroyed by Oona.
timeline.quote: until only one remained: Colfenor , the Last Yew; who only produced The Sapling , which was destroyed by Oona .

citation.text: "Treefolk", section "Yew Treefolk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona creates the Vendilion siblings in the final days before the Great Aurora.
timeline.quote: The Vendilion siblings were created by the Great Mother Oona in the final days before the Great Aurora

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The clique secretly spies on Rhys, Brigid and Maralen and reports to Oona.
timeline.quote: the trio was, in actuality, secretly spying on them and reporting their movements to Oona

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Assignment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The clique whisks Maralen away to Glen Elendra as a gift to Oona.
timeline.quote: the siblings had whisked her away to Glen Elendra as a gift to their queen.

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The clique learns Maralen is a faerie duplicate and begins to obey her.
timeline.quote: the clique was informed then of Maralen's origins as a faerie duplicate

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona bottles the sky one night and releases it the next after aligning the stars.
timeline.quote: One night Oona bottled the sky.

citation.text: Elsewhere Flask (Shadowmoor, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Brigid, Captain Sygg and the Source of the Wanderbrine subdue the Destroyer; Maralen gains the elemental power instead of Oona.
timeline.quote: but Maralen, aided by the scroll of Rosheen Meanderer , gained the power instead

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Reduced to a flamekin again, Ashling repents and helps Maralen's party defeat and destroy Oona.
timeline.quote: repented for her actions and tried to atone by helping Maralen's party defeat and destroy Oona

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor meets Gaddock Teeg and retains Ashling to reach Rhys, while Oona's Vendilion clique spies on him.
timeline.quote: Colfenor tasked Ashling with reaching his former apprentice, Rhys.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The sapling plays a role in the Great Aurora and the war between Oona and Maralen but does not survive; a cutting is saved and revived as Ferrafor.
timeline.quote: The sapling would not survive the ensuing conflict

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Cayr Ulios the Wilt-Leaf royalty elevate Gryffid to First Vigilant; persuaded by Oona's demonstration, he agrees to protect Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: elevated him to the rank of First Vigilant.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gryffid finds the king and queen suspended by Oona's vines and sacrifices himself to sunder the main link, immolating himself and the royal pair and depriving Oona of Cayr Ulios's magic.
timeline.quote: When he sundered the main vine, the surge of magical energy immolated him along with the king and queen.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oura proclaims herself queen by mimicking Oona.
timeline.quote: Oura proclaimed herself queen by mimicking Oona and gaining power through the collective belief of the fae.

citation.text: "List of secondary characters/Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Oura". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona creates two faerie siblings, the first of whom, Oko, is meant to rule Shadowmoor but rebels.
timeline.quote: This sibling rebelled and desired to rule in adherence to the natural cycle of the world

citation.text: "Oona", section "The Shadowmoor prince". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona orders the death of Oko's father-figure; Oko vanishes vowing never to forgive her.
timeline.quote: Oona ordered the death of her progeny's newfound father-figure

citation.text: "Oona", section "The Shadowmoor prince". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona raises her younger daughter in seclusion and deprives her of warmth as a weapon against the coming aurora.
timeline.quote: The faerie was reared to be a weapon against the world that Oona feared would rise against her

citation.text: "Oona", section "The Shadowmoor prince". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4520 AR Oona spies on Colfenor through the Vendilion clique, which she created as scouts.
timeline.quote: a trio of faerie emissaries that she created in the face of the Great Aurora to act as her personal scouts and spies

citation.text: "Oona", section "The final Great Aurora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona kills the elf Maralen and replaces her with her half-formed daughter, who gains unintended sentience; the Vendilion bring her before Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona used her magic to kill an elf woman named Maralen and replaced her with her half-formed daughter

citation.text: "Oona", section "The final Great Aurora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen returns to her companions unaware she travels with Oona's spies, and conflict grows between her and Oona.
timeline.quote: the insuppressible autonomy of Maralen quickly led to unresolved conflict between the two

citation.text: "Oona", section "The final Great Aurora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona tries to take Ashling's elemental power but is thwarted by Maralen, Brigid Baeli and Sygg, then retreats to Cayr Ulios and drains the elves.
timeline.quote: She tried to take the elemental power of Ashling , but was thwarted by Maralen

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gryffid sacrifices himself to sever Oona's hold on the elves and weaken her.
timeline.quote: Her control was thwarted when Gryffid sacrificed himself to sever her connection to the Elves and weaken her.

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen and Oona fight in single combat above Cayr Ulios while their faerie armies clash.
timeline.quote: The two engaged in single combat as their Faerie armies clashed with each other.

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated at Glen Elendra with the sacrifice of the Sapling of Colfenor and the combined power of Maralen and Ashling's elemental; Maralen becomes queen of the fae as day returns.
timeline.quote: Maralen took her place as queen of the fae as day returned to the plane.

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Though her body is destroyed, Oona's consciousness survives in the plane and she creates a new trio of faeries to replace the Vendilion.
timeline.quote: she created a new trio of Faeries to replace the Vendilion clique

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Scion kills the Druai on Oona's order for failing and defying her.
timeline.quote: he is slain by the Scion upon Oona's order for failing and defying her orders

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Pawn of the Banshee, by Doug Beyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Oona's downfall, changelings remain in Lorwyn unless driven into Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: Since Oona's downfall, changelings remain in Lorwyn unless they are driven into Shadowmoor unwillingly.

citation.text: "Shapeshifter", section "Mimics". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sygg helps Maralen and Brigid ambush Ashling; Maralen betrays him and keeps the Crescent.
timeline.quote: She kept the Crescent and united the power of two greater elementals, fire and water, in herself.

citation.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar", section "After the Great Aurora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A hobgoblin dragoon's lance ends faeries' mockery in Oona's skies.
timeline.quote: But his lance ended their mockery

citation.text: Hobgoblin Dragoon (Eventide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Maralen seeks Ashling's help as Oona's consciousness reasserts itself, bringing news of Isilu and Morcant's plot; they travel to Goldmeadow.
timeline.quote: Ashling was approached by Maralen in her time of crisis

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen steals Ashling's power with the scroll and Crescent and challenges Oona.
timeline.quote: Maralen succeeded in temporarily stealing Ashling’s power for herself.

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona kills the Sapling of Colfenor, and Rhys absorbs its poison.
timeline.quote: Oona killed the Sapling of Colfenor in a final act of spite

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling regains her power and sanity and joins Rhys against Oona.
timeline.quote: Restored to herself, Ashling joined Rhys in a final assault against Oona.

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen deals Oona the killing blow with moonglove.
timeline.quote: Maralen dealt the killing blow using moonglove

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona is reborn in secret in Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: she was shown to be reborn, her essence reconstituted in secret.

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4520 AR faeries slaughter a Mornsong wedding convoy.
timeline.quote: In 4520 AR , a group of faeries descended on a Mornsong wedding convoy and slaughtered them all.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "The duplicate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona kills the elf Maralen as she picks moonglove and replaces her with a faerie duplicate.
timeline.quote: An elf named Maralen was singled out and killed by Oona as she unsuspectingly picked moonglove .

citation.text: "Maralen", section "The duplicate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Vendilion clique takes Maralen directly to Oona after failing to read her mind.
timeline.quote: took her then directly to Oona

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Meeting her maker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen comes to understand she is a fae duplicate created by Oona to carry her essence into Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: She was a fae duplicate created by Oona to bear her memories and essence into the coming darkness of Shadowmoor

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Meeting her maker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sharing Rosheen's dreamscape, Maralen decides to defy Oona.
timeline.quote: Maralen awoke, freshly determined to defy the queen and greet the uncertain new world to do so.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "The thorn princess". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen is revealed to be a twin of Oona, defies her, and takes the Crescent of Morningtide from Brigid Baeli.
timeline.quote: Later, she took the Crescent of Morningtide from Brigid Baeli and challenged Oona to face her in a direct fight.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen, with Rhys, Ashling and two elementals, destroys Oona and becomes queen of the fae.
timeline.quote: Oona was destroyed and wiped from the face of Lorwyn.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated by Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor's sapling, though her consciousness survives.
timeline.quote: Though Oona was defeated and her body was destroyed, her consciousness remains hidden

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Oona's defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona lures Veesa back into her service, shattering the clique.
timeline.quote: Later, Oona managed to lure Veesa back into her service, shattering the clique completely.

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Disbanding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona kills the sapling and the groundlings; Endry survives losing a wing.
timeline.quote: Oona unleashed a counterattack, killing the sapling by cutting her in two with a thornvine

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Disbanding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Rhys and Ashling destroy Oona.
timeline.quote: destroyed Oona by a combination of poison, fire, and water magic.

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Disbanding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona captures the giant Oko called father and has him publicly executed.
timeline.quote: Oona captured the giant Oko called "father" and had him publicly executed.

citation.text: "Oko", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tamira and Sanar find Maralen turning into Oona; Tamira makes Rhys miss his attack and Maralen enlists their help.
timeline.quote: Tamira used probability magic to make him miss his attack and fall out a window

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona's song calls the faeries home and she feasts on their stolen dreams and rumors.
timeline.quote: All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts

citation.text: Distant Melody (Midnight Hunt Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Oona's song calls all faeries home so she can feast on their stolen dreams and rumors.
timeline.quote: All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

citation.text: Distant Melody (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: With Oona's control broken, Eirdu and Isilu reawaken and the day-night cycle begins to merge again.
timeline.quote: Eirdu and Isilu, were reawakened as the twin aspects of the plane began to merge once more

citation.text: "Oona", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Forty years later Oko returns and Maralen fears Oona's return; the siblings reconcile before Eirdu and Isilu.
timeline.quote: The siblings, rejoined for the first time in decades, reconciled in the presence of Eirdu and Isilu

citation.text: "Oona", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona contacts her grandchild Kellan worlds away and beckons him to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: She beckoned him to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor

citation.text: "Oona", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen reveals she is Oko's sister, an avatar of Oona who rebelled and destroyed her.
timeline.quote: She then revealed that she was his sister, another avatar of Oona who had rebelled and destroyed her.

citation.text: "Oko", section "Prodigal son". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated and destroyed, ending her control over the cycle of day and night, but her meddling leaves the plane's aspects bleeding into one another.
timeline.quote: the queen and mother of all faeries, Oona, had been defeated and destroyed, and her control over the cycle of day and night had ended.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: The Great Mending disrupts the Great Aurora cycle, making Oona fear she might be affected.
timeline.quote: This continued until the cycle was disrupted over forty years ago by the Great Mending

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Oona creates a duplicate Maralen and gives it a piece of her soul to preserve her memories.
timeline.quote: she created a duplicate Maralen, a Mornsong elf, and instilled this duplicate with a piece of her soul

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane to Shadowmoor, a coalition of Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys, a kithkin named Brigid, a merrow named Sygg, a flamekin named Ashling, and a treefolk sapling named Colfenor.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys visits Maralen, who is reminded of the pact by which he would kill her if she followed Oona's path.
timeline.quote: Should she show any sign that her slow transformations had started to lead her down her creator's path, Rhys would kill her

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen finds petals of Oona's flesh in her chamber and realizes her independence may be unraveling.
timeline.quote: These were the petals of Oona's flesh, and they couldn't be here, unless—
